data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"The team should adopt an existing experiment tracker but enforce a 'Schema-First' contract via a local middleware layer, rejecting the false dichotomy between building from scratch and accepting rigid tool constraints.","counterconditions":[{"case":"The team lacks the seniority to define a stable schema upfront, leading to analysis paralysis.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"The chosen existing tool has no API or ingestion method compatible with a middleware injection.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"The latency introduced by local schema validation breaks real-time active learning loops.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"Implement a lightweight local adapter (middleware) that intercepts all logging calls.
